item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Middle school teacher arrested in Sarasota after being charged with sexual battery involving a child

item.description: More than six weeks after a crash left 10-year-old Asher Thomson with life-threatening injuries, his family said he's continuing to make progress while the Pasco County community continues to rally around them.
